fields.label: Enable Web Push
fields.description: Off by default. Turn on only after VAPID keys exist and users have opted in.

fields.label: VAPID Subject
fields.description: Contact for push services, e.g. mailto:admin@example.com. Defaults to mailto:noreply@<site>.

fields.label: Landing Workspace Snapshot
fields.description: JSON {user: original default_workspace} saved when role-based landing is enabled; used to restore on disable. Managed by attendance_engine.landing.

fields.label: Testing Start
fields.description: The cutoff. Before this date the engine writes no AUTO flags. Blank means no cutoff — every day is treated as live, exactly as before this feature existed.

fields.label: Go Live
fields.description: Flags dated on or after this day are the official record. Blank with a testing start set means the pilot is still open.

fields.label: Branch Rollout
fields.description: Branches that roll out on their own timetable. A row is used whole and does not inherit the global dates field-by-field.
